intent.instructions: What does the latest customer message do?

criteria.PLACE_ORDER: Customer starts an order, adds items, or gives first details like time, address or payment.
criteria.MODIFY_ORDER: Customer changes something already stated: items, sizes, extras, time, address or payment.
criteria.CONFIRM_ORDER: Customer agrees the order summary is correct.
criteria.MENU_QUESTION: Question about menu items, ingredients, sizes, prices or availability.
criteria.DELIVERY_QUESTION: Question about delivery area, fee, pickup, or opening hours.
criteria.PAYMENT_QUESTION: Question about how to pay or which payment methods work.
criteria.PAYMENT_CLAIM: Customer says they already paid or sent payment.
criteria.ORDER_STATUS: Customer asks where a placed order is or when it will arrive.
criteria.ORDER_PROBLEM: Complaint about a received order: missing, wrong, late, cold or damaged.
criteria.REFUND_REQUEST: Customer asks for their money back or a refund.
criteria.HUMAN_REQUEST: Customer asks to talk to a person or staff member.
criteria.SMALL_TALK: Greeting, thanks, or chit-chat with no request.
criteria.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Request unrelated to ordering food from this business.
criteria.UNKNOWN: Too unclear to tell what the customer wants.
